subject: Adding custom items to a legend.

messages.author: a77d6f4d040e69e2
messages.subject: Adding custom items to a legend.
parts:
Hi All,

I'm trying to create a plot where a subset of points have a special
secondary shape around them. For example, I started with

p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, shape=cyl, colour=gear, size=carb)) +
geom_point()

which categorizes the data by cylinder, gear and carborator. But I
really wanted items wtih carb==8 to be highlighted with a large black
circle. So I modified the plot to be generated by

p <- ggplot(data = mtcars)+
geom_point(aes(wt, mpg, shape=as.factor(cyl), colour=gear,
size=carb))+
geom_point(aes(wt[carb==8], mpg[carb==8]), colour="black",
shape=1, size=7)

And this did almost everything I wanted. The only missing piece is
the legend. How can I added the an item to the legend that signifies
that the black circles of size 7 correspond to carb==8, potentially
with something different as a title like "Carb = MAX"?

Thanks! And happy holidays to all!
--Keith Stevens

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Adding custom items to a legend.
parts:
Hi

At the moment (and also in the next release), that is not easy.
So I suggest manual annotation like this:

p <- ggplot(data = mtcars)+
geom_point(aes(wt, mpg, shape=as.factor(cyl), colour=gear, size=carb))+

geom_point(aes(wt[carb==8], mpg[carb==8]), colour="black", shape=1, size=7) +
annotate("point", 4, 30, colour="black", shape=1, size=7) +
annotate("text", 4, 30, label = "Carb = MAX", hjust = -0.2, size = 3)

--
